visualReview.scope: Full-body beginning/turn/listening strip reviewed. District screenshot confirms dialogue context; UI and the counter partly obscure Jevica, so rig evidence and the separate full-body fixture carry the motion proof.

testFindings: The initial live speed check used performance.now callback execution time. A delayed callback pair represented 166.6 ms of RAF time but only 25 ms between callback execution, inflating the measured speed. The check now uses requestAnimationFrame timestamps and retains its speed bound.

The attempted movement-during-dialogue check encountered the existing dialogueOpen input guard. That behavior is preserved; acceptance checks paused movement and successful manual movement after closing.
A mid-turn close initially stopped body rotation immediately. A failing unit regression led to damped angular-velocity release.
limits: Head and eyes clamp to their supported range when a seated or airborne partner is behind the body; mounted body orientation is preserved.
Lip synchronization, expressive scanning and broader facial acting remain open.
Material and cloth realism and sustained frame pacing are not yet verified to a hyperrealistic standard.
Local Chromium profiling shows median 16.7 ms and p95 50-66.7 ms. This is not a controlled before/after comparison or sustained 60 FPS proof.
